notes: 'whither' and 'whithersoever' are read as rule 22 fusions of the relative with its resumptive šām rather than leaving the adverb unrepresented.
The italic 'the waters of the sea' is added as a supplied subject; the Hebrew clause writes only the verb (rules 7, 17).

'a very great multitude of fish' recasts הַדָּגָה רַבָּה מְאֹד: the article is unrepresented since the ASV writes 'fish' anarthrously, the supplied 'of' stands before the noun under rule 33, and the expansion heads on 'great' under rule 31.
